blocks.text: Excitatory neurotransmitters postsynaptic neurons ki membrane ko Na⁺ ke liye zyada permeable (guzarne dene wala) kar ke un mein nerve impulse (action potential) paida karte hain. Maslan:

items: Acetylcholine motor neurons aur skeletal muscle fibres ke darmiyan, aur bohat se neurons ke darmiyan kaam karta hai.
Glutamate CNS mein kaam karta hai.
Biogenic amines excitatory neurotransmitters hain. Yeh hormones ka kaam bhi karte hain. In mein yeh shamil hain:
Norepinephrine CNS aur sympathetic nerves mein banta hai. Yeh neend ke andaz (sleep patterns), tawajjuh (focus) aur chaukasi (alertness) ko qaboo karta hai.
Epinephrine adrenal glands aur brainstem mein chhoota hai. Yeh neend mein kirdar ada karta hai aur insan ko chaukas hone aur chaukas rehne ke qabil banata hai.
Dopamine dimagh ka neurotransmitter hai. Yeh jism ki harkat, hosla (motivation) se jure lutf aur jazbati ubhaar ko qaboo karta hai.

Serotonin aant (intestine) ke neurons (taqreeban 90%) aur CNS (10%) banate hain. Yeh bhook, neend, yaad dasht aur seekhna, darja-e-hararat (temperature), mizaj (mood), rawayya aur muscles ke sukarne waghaira ko qaboo karta hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Dopamine chhorne wale neurons ke khatam hone (degeneration) se Parkinson's disease ki kapkapi (muscle tremors) hoti hai.
Serotonin chhorne wale neurons ki kam sargarmi se depression (udasi ki bimari) ho sakta hai. Kai antidepressant dawayein synaptic cleft se serotonin ka hatna rok deti hain. Is tarah serotonin cleft mein rehta hai aur depression kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab tamam biogenic amines ko excitatory kehti hai. Asal mein transmitter jagata hai ya rokta hai, yeh us receptor par munhasir hai jis se woh jurta hai; dopamine, norepinephrine aur serotonin mukhtalif synapses par dono tarah kaam karte hain.

Yeh neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron tak nerve impulse jane ka imkan kam karte hain. Jab yeh postsynaptic neuron ke receptors se jurte hain to sodium channels (jo cell ko jaga dete) ki jagah chloride ions ke channels khul jate hain. Nateeje mein chloride ions (Cl⁻) neuron ke andar diffuse hote hain aur membrane ke andar ko RMP se bhi zyada manfi kar dete hain. Yeh hyperpolarization rokne wala (inhibitory) asar paida karti hai. Inhibitory neurotransmitters ki misalein yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan "RPM" chhapa hai; sahi lafz RMP (resting membrane potential) hai.

items: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) CNS ka sab se bara inhibitory neurotransmitter hai. Yeh poore nervous system mein neurons ka josh (excitability) kam karta hai. Yeh jism ke mukhtalif kaamon aur rawayye ko qaboo karne mein madad deta hai. Yeh ghabrahat (anxiety), tanao (stress) aur dar kam karta hai, aur sukoon aur neend laata hai.
Glycine khaas taur par spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein inhibitory neurotransmitter hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Kai sukoon-awar (sedative) dawayein GABA ke apne receptors se jurne ko barha deti hain, is tarah synapse par GABA ka asar barh jata hai.

Endorphins dimagh ke neurons se chhootne wale inhibitory neurotransmitters hain. Yeh dard ke paigham le jane wale excitatory neurotransmitters ka ikhraj (release) kam karte hain. Is tarah yeh dard ke signals ko dimagh ke mutalliqa hisse tak pohanchne se rok dete hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Afeem (opium) aur us se bani cheezein, morphine aur heroin, analgesic (dard kam karne wala) asar rakhti hain kyun ke un ki kimiyai banawat endorphins jaisi hai. Is liye yeh aasani se endorphins ke receptors se jur jati hain.

blocks.title: Nerve gas ka acetylcholine par asar
blocks.text: Excitatory neurotransmitter acetylcholine neuromuscular junctions par motor neurons se chhoota hai. Yeh skeletal muscles ko sukarne par ubharta hai. Phir acetylcholinesterase enzyme use tor deta hai. Nerve gas (maslan sarin, tabun, soman) bohat zehreela kimiyai madda hai jo is enzyme ko rok deta hai. Is se acetylcholine jama ho jata hai, skeletal muscle hadd se zyada jagta hai aur muscles sukre rehte hain. Agar diaphragm muscle sukra rahe to insan saans nahin le sakta. Doosre asraat mein muscles ka pharakna, dauray (convulsions), saans ki takleef aur aakhir mein maut shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Inhibitory neurotransmitter neuron ke fire karne ka imkan kaise kam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sodium ke bajaye chloride channels kholta hai; Cl⁻ andar aata hai aur andar RMP se bhi zyada manfi ho jata hai (hyperpolarization), to action potential ke liye zyada bara stimulus chahiye.

items: Excitatory (Na⁺ ke liye permeability barhate): acetylcholine, glutamate, biogenic amines (norepinephrine, epinephrine, dopamine, serotonin).
Inhibitory (Cl⁻ andar, hyperpolarization): GABA, glycine, endorphins. Nerve gas acetylcholinesterase ko rokti hai, muscles sukre rehte hain.
